explication: Matomo is a self-hosted analytics platform: website tracking data is collected and stored, then exposed as reports through its API and interface. The README also identifies privacy controls, customizable dashboards, and plugin-based features such as goals and ecommerce. The graph includes those documented capabilities; some runtime wiring is dashed because the sampled excerpts do not show the relevant calls.
